shots.note: continues S01's two-shot across the pedestal: 도원 (left) and 하온 (right), the ember glowing between them; it starts to flicker
insert: the ember flickers, dims and shrinks on the pedestal
close, low: a skeleton beside the aisle stirs, half lifts itself and sinks back
medium: 하온's head snaps toward the skeleton behind her (it settles back in the background); 도원 looks too
over 도원's right shoulder down the hall axis: he steps aside and points at the sealed gate far away past 하온; she turns to look
medium on 하온: she has turned and looks down the hall at the gate, 도원 still pointing behind her
medium on the pickup: 하온 takes the dimmed ember from the pedestal with her left hand and draws it in front of her
close on 하온 and the ember in her hand: it brightens a little; she looks up to 도원, he nods; she turns toward the gate
side tracking, left to right: 하온 walks down the aisle toward the gate holding the ember in front of her
final wide from behind 도원: the old keeper watches, 하온 small in the aisle walking toward the sealed gate with the ember
